specs.story_title: Android CLI packages device workflows as reusable agent skills
specs.subject: Reusable Android CLI agent skills and device automation
specs.composition: Layered mobile-automation workshop: reusable skill capsules feed a command rail that orchestrates device-state inspection, a live screen stream, bounded test actions and signed result evidence.

specs.story_title: Copilot metrics expose a hidden failure mode in agent telemetry
specs.subject: Agent activity telemetry that can silently disappear when client and metrics contracts diverge
specs.composition: Diagnostic observability pipeline with client-version lanes, schema compatibility gate, metrics ingestion, usage report and evidence comparator exposing missing activity.

specs.story_title: Claude Frontier Academy targets the forward-deployed engineering skills gap
specs.subject: Practical learning pipeline for forward-deployed AI engineering
specs.composition: Technical academy blueprint moving from capability modules through sandbox exercises, customer-context simulations, deployment patterns and evidence review into a competency matrix.

specs.subject: Enterprise AI adoption at workforce scale with governance and enablement
specs.composition: Hub-and-spoke enterprise adoption architecture with a governed AI service core, abstract work-domain clusters, policy, access, training, support and usage-evidence rails.

specs.story_title: Ambient agents turn events into resumable human-approved workflows
specs.subject: Event-driven ambient agents with durable state, approval interrupts and safe resume
specs.composition: Circular event-driven state machine with event intake, isolated job state, policy gate, bounded tool work, approval checkpoint, persisted pause state, resume and audit evidence.

specs.story_title: AgentCore gives Claude Desktop a governed web-search path
specs.subject: Governed desktop-agent web search through MCP and an AgentCore control boundary
specs.composition: Secure retrieval corridor from desktop assistant through MCP into an AgentCore gateway where identity and policy gate web search and provenance-filtered source evidence returns.
